lines.text: [excited] Why do heavy-lift drones go twelve S? Half the current, same power!
Twelve LiPo cells in series. Forty-four point four volts nominal.
Three kilowatts at six S? About a hundred and thirty-five amps. At twelve S? Around sixty-eight.
Less current means less heat in your cables and connectors, and lighter wiring.
Pro tip: size your pack from the stated amps, not the C number.
[excited] Six S or twelve S... what does your drone run? Tell us in the comments!
